Long Description of Sighting Report
At approximately 235am this morning I was getting ready to leave for work, and my dog insisted on going outside. For whatever reason I followed her out, which I almost never do. I looked up in the sky to the east toward Brentwood and noticed what I first thought to be the ISS.

It was traveling a little faster than a satellite, and was a little brighter than ISS. I remember thinking that can't be ISS, I get alerts for when it's in the area. I continued to gaze at it, and I thought, wouldn't that be strange if it all of a sudden stopped?

As soon as I thought that, the object stopped. My breath was taken away. It slowly started moving in my direction, then another direction, then very slowly movrd toward downtown Antioch.

I noticed movement near the star like craft. It would occasionally dim to a low light, and when it did, I noticed 4-5 other much smaller star like craft, with a very low glow, zipping around the area of the craft. They seemed to be interacting.

I stood in absolute awe and amazement, not worried if I was late for work. I did not have my phone on me, and my wife was asleep inside. I knew if I ran inside to grab my phone, the craft would disappear. I ran in to get my phone and by the time I came out, it was indeed gone. As I drove to work, I scanned the skies but did not see it.

It was last seen at approximately 0140am, slowly moving toward the west.

Long Description of Sighting Report
I was driving from Martinsville when I saw a light in the sky as if it was just a bright star. I was pretty far away so I didn’t think anything of it. As I got into Casey it was so bright I knew it wasn’t a star. It staying in the same spot for while. I turned on a side ride next to 2 cornfields when it finally moved about one of the fields. It eventually crossed the road to another cornfield and hovered above. I stopped my car and rolled my windows down to listen for any type of noise like a helicopter or something and it was completely silent. Soon after that it lights got bigger and bigger as if it was coming right at me, so then I took off. I didn’t see anything else after that, it disappeared.
